pages.text: Five sheets of paper lay on the lodge table. The five friends drew pictures.
Leo drew the fastest. "I'm good at drawing."
Leo looked beside him. Mei's mountain was crooked.
"You should draw it like this." Leo drew a long line on Mei's paper.
A black line crossed Mei's mountain. Mei pulled the paper closer.
Leo touched Soso's paper too. Soso folded it up.
The pictures hung in a row on the wall. Beside a picture crossed by a black line was folded paper.
Grandma Bear tapped Leo's paper. "Show how well you draw on your own paper."
Leo spread out a fresh sheet. He drew only on his own paper.
Leo's picture went on the wall. The four stood in front of it and looked for a long time.
